findings.text: Unset removes elements from ExpectedCalls while ranging over the original slice with a fixed index `i`. After one removal the indices shift. An adjacent matching call is skipped, so it stays registered. With three or more matches, or with two matches that sit next to each other, `ExpectedCalls[i+1:]` can exceed the shortened slice length and panic. For example, if `On("f", Anything)` is registered twice and `Unset` is called, the second iteration slices `[:1]` and `[2:]` on a slice of length 1.
